Meta.MetaString:
Begin your tech journey and gain real-world experience as an User Request Engineer Intern in our Support Team at Dassault Systemes in Krakow!
In this role, you will support the team in maintaining internal tools, managing licenses and improving processes that keep our systems running smoothly. It is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in an international tech environment and develop both technical and soft skills.

Availability of at least 20 hours per week is required.

Responsibilities

  • Support daily activities of the Support team
  • Manage incoming Service Reports: categorize, prioritize and distribute them
  • Create and maintain internal tools
  • Handle software and license distribution orders
  • Reproduce, validate and test reported case scenarios
  • Participate in management activities of virtual environments
  • Prepare reports, statistics, and training materials
  • Contribute to process improvement projects and participate in team meetings
  • Provide responsive support for business areas

 

Qualifications

  • Experience with virtual environments and OS management
  • Basic knowledge of C#, HTML/JavaScript and SQL
  • MS Office (Excel) skills
  • Fluent in Polish and proficiency in English
  • Great communication and problem-solving skills
  • Actively enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or related field (or relevant experience)
  • Proactive, self-driven and comfortable working both independently and in a team

 

What’s in it for you

  • Great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in technical support within the IT industry
  • Supportive and knowledgeable team, ready to share expertise and best practices  
  • Wide variety of projects and tasks, ambitious goals and independence in achieving them
  • Flexible working hours
  • Chillout rooms
  • Access to training platform (languages, soft/hard skills)
  • Multinational work environment
  • And last but not least: Healthy Breakfast once a month, Fruity Tuesdays, Sweets on Thursdays, public transport compensation and MultiLife platform access

Interested? Click on "Apply" to upload your application documents

Meta.name: content_summary
Meta.MetaString:
We are looking for a results-oriented and relationship-focused Strategic Client Executive Aerospace and Defense with a focus on dedicated accounts to start at the earliest possible date: [More about the industry: https://www.3ds.com/de/industries/aerospace-defense]. 
The role can be performed in a hybrid setting from one of our 3DS locations, such as in Warsaw or Krakow. Willingness to travel to our customers across Poland and the D-A-CH region is essential.

Role Description & Responsibilities 

  • Strategic management of dedicated customers with responsibility for revenue and growth targets
  • Development and implementation of a customised account strategy in close collaboration with internal specialists
  • Establishment and maintenance of sustainable business relationships at decision-maker and C-level
  • Positioning of our consulting approach "Value Engagement" with a focus on added value for the customer
  • Identification of business opportunities and implementation of customer-specific sales initiatives; coordination and management of internal resources as well as external partners for the successful execution of the customer strategy
  • Responsibility for pipeline and forecast management for the managed accounts.

Qualifications

  • Completed studies in engineering, manufacturing or business administration or equivalent qualifications
  • Proven direct sales experience for the Poland and DACH regions, managing sales processes and developing long-term strategic customer relationships, frequently engaging at C level 
  • Proven experience of direct value selling to (and awareness of decision making processes within) the Aerospace and Defense, Public Sector or High Tech industries is essential
  • Direct experience of selling complex software solutions, or ERP is preferred - ideally in complex sales structures or major client projects 
  • Excellent relationship management skills and the ability to develop long-term customer partnerships; outstanding communication skills at all management levels; fluent in Polish and English languages is a key requirement; German and/or French is an advantage
  • Direct experiences of identifying business potential and implementing strategic initiatives to increase revenue, delivering quota expectations and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams and external partners

What’s in it for you

  • Strategic responsibility for top clients in a forward-looking industry
  • Dynamic and team-oriented corporate culture with plenty of scope for design
  • Attractive remuneration package and employer-private pension plan
  • Flexible working hours, remote and hybrid models, 25 days of holiday, bridge days and numerous benefits
  • Individual training and career development programmes

We look forward to receiving your CV - please in English - including details of your availability and salary expectations. Feel free to use our career platform for this.

Meta.name: content_summary
Meta.MetaString:
In the role of Sales Management Aerospace and Defense for EuroCentral, you will take on a central responsibility for our customers in the Aerospace and Defense industry. You will work closely with interdisciplinary teams, build trusting customer relationships, and develop forward-thinking solutions. Your contribution strengthens business success and the sustainable expansion of our partnerships.
The role can be carried out in a location-independent hybrid manner from one of our 3DS locations such as in Warsaw or Krakow. Willingness to travel to our customers across Poland and the D-A-CH region is essential. 

Role Description & Responsibilities 

  • You will take on the disciplinary leadership of 5 colleagues in the Aerospace and Defense Sales team and support their development with a clear focus on collaboration and mutual growth.
  • You will develop viable sales strategies and design targeted customer approaches – at eye level with contacts in senior positions. Together with our industry and presales specialists, you will identify relevant customer potentials and coordinate tailored offers.
  • You will support customers with methodological consulting ("Value Engagement") and promote a partnership-based solution development.
  • You will accompany major customer projects, bring your experience in consultative selling to bear, and assist in evaluation, offer design, and negotiation.
  • You will work in partnership with our sales partners and provide advisory support when it comes to complex customer projects.

Qualifications

  • A successfully completed degree in engineering, manufacturing or business studies (or a comparable qualification) 
  • Proven direct sales experience within Poland and the DACH region, managing sales processes and developing long-term strategic customer relationships, frequently engaging at C level 
  • Relevant leadership experience, e.g. in leading and coaching sales teams or in the professional management of project groups
  • Proven experience of direct value selling to the Aerospace and Defense, Public Sector or High Tech industries is essential 
  • Direct experience of selling software, or ERP is preferred – ideally in complex sales structures or major client projects 
  • Strong communication skills, team orientation and a confident presence at all levels of the organisation – even in an international context; fluent Polish and English language skills are essential, German and/or French is an advantage 

What’s in it for you

  • A high level of responsibility in a complex environment and the opportunity to build knowledge and networks in the major customer sector
  • Dynamic, flexible and team-oriented working atmosphere
  • Market-competitive attractive salary, employer-private pension plan
  • Flexible working hours, hybrid working model with 2 remote days a week, 25 days holiday, bridge days and numerous benefits 
  • Diverse continuing education and career development programmes

We look forward to receiving your CV - please in English - including details of your availability and salary expectations. Feel free to use our career platform for this.

Become a part of the DELMIA R&D team as a DevOps Intern! You will play an active role in our daily operations while working closely with experienced team members, gaining hands-on experience in a collaborative and supportive environment. We offer comprehensive training and opportunity to help you grow your technical skills and build a strong foundation for your career in DevOps. We are looking for someone who is passionate about modern technologies, automation and innovative software development.
Availability of at least 25 hours per week is required.

Role description & Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain automation solutions
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines
  • Support infrastructure management (VMware)
  • Implement logging and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus)
  • Troubleshoot deployment failures, perform root cause analysis and establishing disaster recovery procedures
  • Support high availability and scalability using Docker containers and Kubernetes
  • Research new technologies, conduct analyses and develop prototypes for innovative solutions

Qualifications

  • Understanding of DevOps processes and principles
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
  • Knowledge of CI/CD and IaC tools (GitLab, Jenkins, Git)
  • Basic programming skills in Shell scripting, PowerShell, and Python
  • Knowledge of Windows and Linux administration
  • Willingness to learn, develop and continuously improve your skills
  • Good communication skills in Polish and English
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, with user empathy and attention to detail and aesthetics

What’s in it for you

  • Great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in technical support within the IT industry
  • Supportive and knowledgeable team, ready to share expertise and best practices  
  • Wide variety of projects and tasks, ambitious goals and independence in achieving them
  • Flexible working hours
  • Chillout rooms
  • Access to training platform (languages, soft/hard skills)
  • Multinational work environment
  • And last but not least: Healthy Breakfast once a month, Fruity Tuesdays, Sweets on Thursdays, public transport compensation and MultiLife platform access

Interested? Click on "Apply" to upload your application documents

Meta.MetaString:
We are seeking a Tester to join the Test Factory within the DELMIA Hub organization. In this role, you will be responsible for testing web applications, creating test cases, and performing both manual and automated testing.
DELMIA, a Dassault Systèmes brand, connects the virtual and real worlds to drive innovation and sustainability. Powered by the 3DEXPERIENCE platform, our end-to-end solutions integrate virtual twins, industrial AI and augmented reality to optimize manufacturing, supply chains and workforces. We empower businesses to reduce waste and achieve sustainable, customer-focused operations, building a more resilient future.

Role Description & Responsibilities

  • Create test cases and test scripts to validate software functionality
  • Conduct manual and automated tests across different environments (web, mobile, etc.) and perform different types of testing focusing on functional and regression testing
  • Identify, track, and report software defects and issues using bug-tracking systems, and then follow up on their resolution
  • Work closely with developers, business analysts, project managers, and other teams to understand requirements and resolve issues
  • Provide objective feedback on software quality and suggest improvements to the development process
  • Document test results, create summary reports, and maintain version control for all documentation and scripts
     

Qualifications

  • Experience with automated testing tools like Selenium or Appium (for automation testers)
  • Experience with various testing types, such as functional and usability testing; performance and security is a plus
  • Knowledge of the software development life cycle and familiarity with different testing methodologies
  • Analytical and logical thinking skills to identify potential issues early. Attention to detail to spot bugs and vulnerabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to document bugs and collaborate with the team
  • Good problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. Ability to work effectively in a team environment

 

What’s in it for you?

  • Attractive salary, proportional to the demonstrated skills and experience
  • Employment in a stable company with well-established market position
  • Challenging job in a dynamic and multinational environment
  • Excellent work atmosphere in an ambitious and professional team
  • Rich benefits package

Interested? Click on "Apply" to upload your application documents
